speaker: CAPTAIN
text: Brace! Brace! Brace for impact!

speaker: EMMA
text: Dad, what's happening?

speaker: DAD
text: Head down! Hold my hand, and don't let go!

speaker: CAPTAIN
text: Mayday, mayday! Flight four one seven, going down!

speaker: DAD
text: Emma? Emma!

speaker: EMMA
text: Dad! I'm here!

speaker: DAD
text: Get away from the plane. Run!

speaker: GRACE
text: Over here! Are you two hurt?

speaker: DAD
text: We're okay. Who else made it?

speaker: GRACE
text: Just us. And the pilot. He's trapped.

speaker: PILOT
text: My leg. I can't feel my leg.

speaker: PILOT
text: Please, don't leave me here.

speaker: DAD
text: On three. One, two, three!

speaker: GRACE
text: His leg is bad. Really bad.

speaker: EMMA
text: Is someone coming for us?

speaker: GRACE
text: Not tonight.

speaker: GRACE
text: That's all the water we have. Two bottles.

speaker: DAD
text: His leg is infected. Without water, he won't make it through the night.

speaker: PILOT
text: The emergency beacon. I'm the only one who can fix it.

speaker: EMMA
text: Dad, I'm so thirsty.

speaker: DAD
text: If I give him the water, Emma goes without.

speaker: PILOT
text: And if you don't, nobody ever finds you.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your daughter, or the only man who can get you home? Comment A or B.
